fixed.member: UI CSS justify-self, justify-items in a block
fixed.summary: `justify-self` and `justify-items` now align a block container's block-level children in its inline axis (CSS Box Alignment 3 §6.1.1); an `auto` width aligned anything but `normal` or `stretch` shrinks to `fit-content`. They used to apply only in grids, so such a child stayed at the start.
